lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: The coordinates on the map match the waveform. Courier 19 encoded the restricted sector before he died.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: The Choir list is real. Names I processed at the desk — Sen, Brent, Dain — all on it.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Clerk 1147-F. Exterior transit concluded. Return to processing.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: The buffer holds senders the desk cannot see. I need to understand what happens upstairs before they close the next case.
